title: Ordinary realization of the clopen section factor
statement: Let R_n be arbitrary commutative rings with transitions and n a natural number. For any commutative proper/open square k:V→W, r:V→S, p:W→T, i:S→T with k,i quasi-compact open and r,p proper, put P=W×_T S, b:P→W, q:P→S and s=(k,r):V→P. The sectionArrow factor (q^* then b_! to r^* then k_!) is the clopen projector for s followed by the outgoing pullback and open composition identifications, as in def-sp-varying-ring-clopen-arrow-factors. For the explicit ordinary realization and comparisons of [lem-sp-varying-ring-ordinary-evaluation-comparisons], E_W(moduleSectionArrow_N); j_k(r^*N); J_k(g_r,N) equals j_b(q^*N); J_b(g_q,N); strictSectionArrow_(E_S N). This statement does not include the cartesian beta factor.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 03DI and 09AE for open adjunctions, 0F7B for the intrinsic clopen construction. This normalization is an agent-formulated consequence.

proof.text: Apply the bare clopen-projector realization equation to s=squareLift(k,r), at q^*N with q=pullback.snd p i. Apply b_! with b=pullback.fst p i. The ordinary open-composition normalization identifies the resulting s_!,b_! composite with k_!. The inverse of the ordinary pullback-composition normalization identifies s^*q^* with r^*. Naturality of the open comparisons moves the realized section and pullback compositor through the open comparison; naturality of strict jComp moves the pullback comparisons through its compositor. Substitute the projector equation, then use naturality of strict pi with the q^* comparison. Equality elimination for s≫b=k and s≫q=r accounts for both congruence isomorphisms. Associators have identity components, so their component expressions are exactly moduleSectionArrow and strictSectionArrow.

theorem ordinarySectionEvaluation (n : ℕ) {V W S T : Scheme.{u}}
    (k : V ⟶ W) (r : V ⟶ S) (p : W ⟶ T) (i : S ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i]
    [IsProper r] [IsProper p] (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) :
    OrdinarySquareComparison
      (EA := ordinaryRealization R φ n V) (EB := ordinaryRealization R φ n W)
      (EC := ordinaryRealization R φ n S)
      (ED := ordinaryRealization R φ n (pullback p i))
      (R₀ := pull R φ r) (P₀ := extension R φ (pullback.fst p i))
      (K := extension R φ k) (I := pull R φ (pullback.snd p i))
      (r := StrictTower.G (R n) r) (p := StrictTower.J (R n) (pullback.fst p i))
      (k := StrictTower.J (R n) k) (i := StrictTower.G (R n) (pullback.snd p i))
      (ordinaryPullComparison R φ n V S r)
      (ordinaryOpenComparison R φ n (pullback p i) W (pullback.fst p i))
      (ordinaryOpenComparison R φ n V W k)
      (ordinaryPullComparison R φ n (pullback p i) S (pullback.snd p i))
      (moduleSectionArrow R φ k r p i h) (strictSectionArrow (R n) k r p i h)
